notes.subject: עברתי על טוב צוארה
notes.rationale: Crux: 'I passed over upon her fair neck' — past mercy (I spared her) vs imminent yoking ('I will put a rider on her neck'); tense of עברתי disputed.

notes.subject: dɔgɔ / foro da / kabaw siri
notes.rationale: The agriculture chain: the free heifer that loved threshing becomes the yoked animal, and all Israel (Ephraim, Judah, Jacob) is conscripted into ploughing — freedom inverted to bondage.

notes.subject: ארכיב אפרים
notes.rationale: 'I will make Ephraim to ride' can also read 'I will set a rider on Ephraim' — who rides whom depends on pointing of the hiphil.

translation: Efrayimu (Efrayimu) ye misikɔrɔbɔ min kalanra, a kanuya dɔgɔli la; n de tɛmɛra a kunbɔ nyumankan kan; n bɛ minɛlabɛn kɛ Efrayimu ye: Yehuda (Yuda) bɛna foro da, Yaaquba (Yakuba) bɛna kabaw siri a ye.
